task.ques: Identify the main headlines covering the UK's plan to tackle climate change on BBC News.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The main BBC News headlines covering the UK's climate plan are:

• “What is net zero and is the UK on track to achieve it?” — 5 November 2025. BBC's overview explains the legally binding 2050 goal and commitments to clean electricity by 2030, ending new fully petrol and diesel car sales by 2030, subsidising heat pumps and investing in carbon capture.
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx238yyr40qo

• “More people buying electric cars and heat pumps than ever before” — 25 June 2025. Climate advisers report progress but call for faster uptake and cheaper electricity.
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqjqzj8rnvyo

• “Will carbon capture help the UK tackle climate change?” — 4 October 2024. Examines the government's £21.7bn funding pledge over 25 years.
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cden6k97n9xo

• “Car firms demand more help to meet 2030 petrol ban” — 25 July 2024. Covers the planned petrol and diesel sales ban and industry calls for electric-car incentives.
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn09pvjpzdjo

• “Is Labour's 2030 green energy goal realistic and how would it affect bills?” — 31 May 2024. Assesses the plan to almost entirely remove fossil fuels from UK electricity production by 2030.
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cmjjy17284vo

Selection focuses on BBC's national net-zero overview and the policy coverage it links to. All headlines and publication dates were read on BBC News. Screenshot evidence: final.png shows the overview's headline, date and explanation of net zero; captured as a viewport and resized to 1280 pixels wide.
